verdict: Organic visibility holding, but overdue milestones are blocking pipeline growth.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, Google Business Profile was the only active channel, combining for 371 total actions — 9 calls, 261 directions, and 101 web clicks — with no paid spend running on any brand. GBP engagement declined sharply in the final week, down 44–58% week-over-week depending on the entity, consistent with a seasonal demand softening but also tied to an unresolved web and SEO fix that is gating visibility recovery. A set of CRM, outreach, and SEO milestones — several overdue since late July and August — remain open and are blocking the downstream work that would turn organic interest into tracked leads. Those blockers are being worked through in order of priority, with the contact pull, stub reconciliation, and SEO root cause fix as the immediate focus ahead of the September 30 checkpoint.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations this period (calls, directions, and website clicks)
search impressions recorded for O'Hare Precision Metals alone over the last 28 days, showing meaningful organic search presence
overdue program milestones across CRM, SEO, and outreach that are actively being resolved in priority order

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement dropped 44–58% across all entities in the last 7 days, and two O'Hare profiles recorded zero calls despite hundreds of impressions this period.
watch_item.fix: The web and SEO root cause fix and contact data pull — both gating visibility and outreach — are the immediate priority ahead of the September 30 checkpoint; call visibility on the zero-call profiles is also being reviewed.
